contract_notes: B1 CANON values remain unchanged; missing inputs are added only under simulation_model with explicit PROPOSED/PENDING provenance.
The simulator must read this BALANCE_MODEL.json and must not duplicate tuning numbers in Python.
Model-only results are not runtime verification.
The architecture contract is the live source for stable IDs, six weapon/six passive slots, separate boss-chest/artifact-offer IDs, unbounded active artifact effects and final-boss NO_CHEST policy.

simulation_model.scope: deterministic 20-minute wave/economy model with a separate encounter clock for every boss checkpoint

main_run_duration_seconds.source: architecture contract canonical duration; B1 section 4

simulation_step_seconds.source: simulation method; not specified by B1
simulation_step_seconds.derived_formula: choose a fixed step smaller than the 0.8-second contact gate and shortest proposed attack interval
simulation_step_seconds.rationale: Keeps spawn, attack, XP, and contact-gate updates deterministic without claiming runtime frame timing.

post_final_boss_window_seconds.derived_formula: upper end of final-boss target window
post_final_boss_window_seconds.rationale: Bounds the final boss encounter after the visible run clock reaches 20:00 without extending the wave/XP clock.

default_seed_set.source: verification protocol; not specified by B1
default_seed_set.derived_formula: fixed independent seeds rather than one happy-path seed
default_seed_set.rationale: Separates deterministic algorithm checks from one output.

rounding_policy.source: B1 uses round(...) without a runtime rounding policy
rounding_policy.derived_formula: round positive economic/stat values to nearest integer, halves upward
rounding_policy.rationale: Avoids language-runtime banker-rounding drift in XP and costs.

base_xp.rationale: Structured copy of the canonical formula so the simulator reads data rather than duplicating B1 literals.

linear_per_level.rationale: Structured copy of the canonical formula.

power_coefficient.rationale: Structured copy of the canonical formula.

power_exponent.rationale: Structured copy of the canonical formula.

xp_pickup_model.source: B1 section 6 defines XP drops and timing targets but not pickup latency/capacity

drop_delay_seconds.derived_formula: drop becomes collectible at defeat_time + drop_delay_seconds
drop_delay_seconds.rationale: Separates combat defeat from visible aftermath and prevents same-frame XP teleportation.

first_level_window_seconds.derived_formula: use the first_level_capacity during the warmup window, then use the band capacity
first_level_window_seconds.rationale: Makes the first meaningful level-up testable without increasing the whole warmup band's XP rate.

first_level_capacity_per_second.rationale: Allows 30 XP to be collected near the 30–45 second target while keeping the remainder of the warmup conservative.

wave_warmup_0_2.rationale: Keeps the first level in the 30–45 second target while the warmup wave remains readable.

wave_pressure_2_5.rationale: Raises progression with the first-pressure wave toward the level-5 target.

wave_threat_5_10.rationale: Supports level 9 around 10 minutes without assuming every spawned enemy is immediately collected.

wave_elite_10_15.rationale: Supports the level-13 target as elite pressure and pickup density increase.

wave_eclipse_15_20.rationale: Supports the level-17–18 target without requiring a new XP drop value.

magnet_capacity_per_rank.source: PENDING_B1; B1 only specifies pickup-radius growth
magnet_capacity_per_rank.rationale: A small proposed link makes magnet progression observable while keeping it weaker than damage branches.

boss_xp_policy.source: PENDING_B1; B1 lists XP drop values but does not map boss XP to progression
boss_xp_policy.derived_formula: main_run_xp = collected ordinary and elite drops; boss XP remains a pending reward/content decision
boss_xp_policy.rationale: Prevents an unconfirmed 250-XP boss grant from invalidating the level-2/5/9/13/17–18 targets.

wave_selection.source: B1 section 4 defines eligible composition but not ratios
wave_selection.composition_formula: weights are normalized only if floating-point sum drifts from 1.0; one weighted choice per spawn budget unit
wave_selection.composition_rationale: preserves B1 roster order, introduces ranged/control pressure before elites, and reserves the final bands for elite pressure without inventing a new enemy ID.

composition_value_provenance.source: PENDING_B1; B1 defines eligible composition but not exact ratios
composition_value_provenance.derived_formula: each band weight is a proposed share of eligible spawn attempts; weights are normalized to sum 1.0
composition_value_provenance.rationale: Ratios are exposed as auditable inputs instead of hidden Python constants.

wave_selection.exact_status: PROPOSED; replace after Product/B1 composition decision

active_cap_scope.source: B1 active cap; boss reservation is not specified
active_cap_scope.derived_formula: count all non-boss active entities against the band cap
active_cap_scope.rationale: Keeps boss encounter readable while preserving the ordinary active-mass cap.

cap_behavior.source: B1 requires an active cap but does not specify overflow
cap_behavior.derived_formula: when cap is full, do not queue unbounded debt; suppressed attempts do not create XP
cap_behavior.rationale: Prevents hidden burst after a boss and bounds memory/CPU.

boss_reserved_slots.source: B1 boss checkpoints; architecture final-run contract
boss_reserved_slots.derived_formula: reserve one boss slot outside ordinary cap
boss_reserved_slots.rationale: A boss must remain spawnable at a checkpoint even when ordinary occupancy is full.

cap_policy.occupancy_measurement: sample active ordinary+elite count every simulation step; report max, mean, p95, cap_seconds

suppression_seconds.rationale: Creates the explicit post-boss breathing window.

suppression_factor.source: B1 says reduced but omits the exact factor
suppression_factor.derived_formula: proposed zero ordinary spawn during the first 8 seconds
suppression_factor.rationale: Makes the boss entrance readable; must be product-approved.

overlap_policy.source: B1 does not define overlapping interruption semantics
overlap_policy.derived_formula: a new checkpoint event restarts the suppression/recovery clock; overlapping bosses are a blocked edge case
overlap_policy.rationale: Deterministic and conservative until runtime boss scheduling exists.

boss_wave_ramp.source: B1 section 4 wave bands and boss checkpoints; user product rule captured 2026-09-10

pre_first_boss_policy.derived_formula: use the existing 0-2 and 2-5 canonical bands before the first boss
pre_first_boss_policy.rationale: The first five minutes already have an explicit warmup-to-pressure progression; the new reset rule starts after a boss.

post_boss_reset_factor.source: PENDING_B1; user requires post-boss waves to restart below the preceding peak
post_boss_reset_factor.derived_formula: entry_budget = preceding_peak_budget × reset_factor; entry_cap = preceding_peak_cap × reset_factor
post_boss_reset_factor.rationale: A 20% reset below the preceding peak is large enough to make the breathing window visible while retaining continuity; exact reset remains a product/balance decision.

siege_duration_seconds.source: PENDING_B1; user requires a peak-density siege before the next boss
siege_duration_seconds.rationale: Reserves the last minute of each five-minute cycle for a stable peak/siege instead of an immediate boss transition.

ramp_curve.source: PENDING_B1; user requires monotonic low-to-peak pressure
ramp_curve.rationale: Linear interpolation is deterministic, auditable, and avoids a hidden step at the start of a new post-boss wave band.

density_formula.value: start_factor = reset_factor × entry_band_budget / peak_band_budget; fraction = clamp((run_elapsed - cycle_start - suppression_seconds - recovery_duration_seconds) / (cycle_duration - suppression_seconds - recovery_duration_seconds - siege_duration_seconds), 0, 1); effective_budget = lerp(entry_band_budget × reset_factor, peak_band_budget, fraction); effective_cap = round(lerp(entry_band_cap × reset_factor, peak_band_cap, fraction))
density_formula.source: B1 canonical band anchors plus post-boss reset decision
density_formula.derived_formula: entry is 80% of the preceding peak; the existing suppression+recovery window completes first; the remaining cycle time ramps to the next canonical band peak; fraction reaches 1.0 before the siege window
density_formula.rationale: Every post-boss cycle has a quiet recovery, then rises monotonically to the next band peak, and stays at peak for the siege window.

recovery_interaction.source: B1 section 4 boss interruption plus existing simulation model
recovery_interaction.derived_formula: effective_spawn_budget = density_curve_budget × boss_interruption_factor; suppression remains zero-spawn, then the existing 0.7-to-1.0 recovery applies
recovery_interaction.rationale: The immediate boss aftermath remains quiet without erasing the longer low-to-peak ramp.

base_damage.source: PENDING_B1; B1 supplies contact gate only

base_speed.rationale: Fast enough to create pressure without making the 0.8-second contact gate irrelevant.

attack_interval_seconds.derived_formula: match canonical contact gate as the minimum repeat interval
attack_interval_seconds.rationale: No same-frame stacking; a rusher cannot hit more often than the contact gate.

contact_delay_seconds.rationale: Gives a moving player a reaction window.

xp_value.source: B1 section 6 gives allowed drop set/range; exact enemy mapping absent
xp_value.derived_formula: choose an integer in the 1–5 beetle range
xp_value.rationale: Early kills should reach the level-2 target without making later levels free.

attack_interval_seconds.derived_formula: telegraph interval selected above the 0.8-second contact gate
attack_interval_seconds.rationale: Leaves time for a reaction and dodge.

contact_delay_seconds.rationale: Ranged unit takes longer to become active pressure.

xp_value.rationale: Preserves the exact canonical moth XP.

combat_math.reference_damage_formula: raw_hit × hero_damage_multiplier × weapon_level_multiplier × passive_multiplier × profile_multiplier × critical_expected_multiplier
combat_math.synergy_damage_formula: base_dps × synergy_damage_multiplier, then clamp synergy_share ≤ 0.40 of total damage

boss_focus_fraction.source: PENDING_B1; player target allocation is not specified
boss_focus_fraction.derived_formula: boss_damage_share = total_attack_damage × boss_focus_fraction while a boss is active
boss_focus_fraction.rationale: A player can continue clearing nearby enemies while deliberately maintaining pressure on the boss; this avoids a fake single-target-only TTK.

weapon_level_damage_per_level.source: PENDING_B1; weapon level damage curve is absent
weapon_level_damage_per_level.rationale: A linear, bounded curve makes level gains visible without making the first six levels a runaway multiplier.

defense_reduction_per_meta_rank.rationale: Directly materializes the canonical +1% damage reduction per rank.

mitigation_cap.rationale: Prevents the proposed defense curve from reaching invulnerability while remaining explicit.

engaged_attacker_limit.source: PENDING_B1; arena collision/targeting limit is not specified
engaged_attacker_limit.derived_formula: incoming_damage = sum of at most engaged_attacker_limit landed attack events per step
engaged_attacker_limit.rationale: Bounds the mean-field threat model to a readable local threat set; the full active cap still measures CPU/occupancy pressure.
